'''Jensen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked in the employ of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was stationed aboard [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jensen appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as the PvP Items vendor for Imperial players on Vaiken Spacedock.<ref name="TOR" />
